sv.title: Riksdagsledamöter kan ha drabbats i taxiintrånget
sv.summary: Bland de drabbade i dataintrånget mot taxibolaget Cabonline kan det finnas riksdagsledamöter, skriver Aftonbladet.

en.title: Members of the Riksdag may have been hit in taxi intrusion
en.summary: Among those affected by the data intrusion against the taxi company Cabonline there may be members of the Riksdag, Aftonbladet writes.
